Executive summary:
- Mid-market product analytics vendor. Heavy realtime chat + embeddings for doc search and personalization.
- Primary ask: start on Hosted API to validate flows, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

- 2026-02-25: POC kickoff — 2-week test using hosted gpt-style open model + embedding index. Focus metrics: 95th/99th latency, token cost, cache hit-rate.

POC / technical notes:
- Workload pattern: mix of short chat sessions (multi-turn), frequent similarity searches against product docs, occasional reranking.
- Targets: UI latency ~ <200ms median, 95th <450ms for chat; embeddings lookups latency target <120ms.
- Throughput: steady-state ~150 rps embeddings, spikes to 350 rps during batch syncs.
- Cost sensitivity: high — product team running slim margins, finance will push for Dedicated if unit economics beat public cloud.
- Model preferences: open model family preferred, okay with quantized variants; fine with dropping to smaller model for fallback.

Workshop goals (agreed):
1) Measure baseline unit-cost on Hosted API.
2) Identify batching & cache settings to hit latency SLOs while cutting per-token cost 30%+.
3) Trial Q4-bit/8-bit quantization profiles on representative prompt sets; quantify quality delta.
4) Produce TCO comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated (1yr commit), include infra/VPC costs + SRE ops.
